content:
Greeting #connections,
I am pleased to inform that I have presented my paper titled "Taxing Pollution and Rewarding Innovation: A Balanced Carbon Penalty and E-ITC Model for Sustainable Growth under GST 2.O" with my co-author and co-presenter Keshav at the International Conference on Economic Intergration and Sectoral Competitiveness Targeting Growth Potential in Agriculture, Manufacturing, Service, E-commerce, Insurance, Healthcare, Real Estate, Rural Industries in the GST-Driven Economy organised by Symbiosis Law School Hyderabad, India, in collaboration with Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR), New Delhi, held on 29th August 2026.

#PaperPresentation
